["Modification(s) Health care providers( HCPs) are a precious entity of COVID 19 pandemic. along with the service to the pandemic, psychological support holds a great significance for frontline defenders. As the stress and burnout increases in HCPs there may be a compromise in the quality of health care services as well as a high chance of spreading infection. so it is important to evaluate the level of stress and burnout in HCPs working in covid units. Result- Majority of HCPs did not show high level stress and burnout. But major participants experienced comparatively a higher level of depression and anxiety. Conducting study in a large population of HCPs may give a better result of stress, anxiety, depression and burnout.


Primary Outcome:

Work-related stress and burnout in health care providers

Comparison of work-related stress and burnout among different groups of health care providers
